structural_limits.detail: All Texture3D resources are descriptor-only in this DumpGPU implementation. TranslateSubresourceDumpDesc only fills SubResourceExtent for Desc.IsTexture2D(), so Texture3D gets ByteSize==0 and IsDumpSupported() returns false. This includes Lumen translucency volumes, radiance-cache indirection and 3D LUTs. Descriptors are retained in inventory.json; their bytes are not in Resources/.
All TextureCube resources are descriptor-only for the same IsTexture2D() gate. The descriptors are retained; cube face bytes are not emitted.
DumpGPU captures resources and pass parameter payloads, not registers or values local to a shader invocation. Shader source mapping is evidence only, not a memory capture.

This DumpGPU implementation names RDG resources and emits per-mip/per-slice subresource binaries, but does not emit RHI descriptor heap entries, SRV/UAV objects or the full view descriptor table. Passes.json names resource versions bound to each pass; it is not a full descriptor dump.
Only resources referenced by an RDG pass can be discovered. RHI-external resources, resources never viewed by a pass, swapchain/backbuffer state and driver-private allocations are not listed.

DefaultByteAddressBuffer, DefaultStructuredBuffer, DefaultBuffer and VirtualTexture_FeedbackBuffer are skipped with ERDGBufferFlags::SkipTracking; their bytes are not in the dump. Exact warning lines are preserved above.

r.DumpGPU.RedumpInputs=0. When a resource is modified in place, later passes link to the one dumped producer version instead of a per-read duplicate. Passes.json preserves the version linkage; the bytes are the recorded version.

Depth/stencil and sub-4-byte channel textures are copied through a staging preprocess. Stored bytes are the postprocessed format recorded in the descriptor/analysis, not the native RHI layout. PF_X24_G8 stencil is emitted as a separate subresource when present.

Referenced uniform-buffer contents are present only because the read-only CVar r.RHI.UniformBufferContentMap.Enable=1 was set at process start via an ini override. Its capture-time value is in Base/ConsoleVariables.csv.
r.DumpGPU.Upload=0 and r.DumpGPU.Explore=0; nothing was uploaded and no file explorer was opened. The raw directory is local only.

portable_paths_note: Absolute host paths were replaced by portable public placeholders; measurements, hashes, sizes and resource records are unchanged.
